title: Vibrant Spicy Japanese Udon Noodles
description: A spicy and indulgent Japanese dish featuring udon noodles, herbes-de-provence, and a blend of Asian flavors, served in a traditional Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the udon noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the herbes-de-provence, gochujang, and soy sauce, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked udon noodles to the skillet and toss to combine with the sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a Korean brass bowl and top with toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions.
Garnish with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
Steam the dish for 2-3 minutes to warm the brass bowl and noodles before serving.
